THE QUESTION BEHIND THE HOURS

Who can afford
to be available?

This explorer measures schedule overlap. It does not measure lost wages, denied services, or staff performance. A clash with work may mean using leave, changing a shift, finding a remote alternative, or postponing a visit. Those outcomes need separate evidence.
